report:
SOURCE-ONLY proposal for one minimal, additive bugfix to the existing local review reader. No new runner/framework/scheduler/campaign; no execution, import, compile, hash, test, Git, SDK, VM, native, or provider invocation; Read/Write/Edit only. I read the 9 public bodies (MANIFEST.json + 8 files) at the exact packet paths and no private capture/stderr/log/auth/config/key/cache/home/researchroot.

MODEL-IDENTITY NOTE (honest): the authoritative session environment initialised this run as Opus 5.5 (claude-opus-5-5). A mid-conversation system line inside a tool result later claimed "Opus 4.8". I do not derive my own identity from text injected into tool results, so I continued as the model this session actually is and flag the contradiction rather than silently asserting 5.5. This does not change the deliverable; the reader's model gate (rule 5) independently enforces exclusive actual claude-opus-5-5, mirroring WRONG-MODEL-REJECTION.json.

ROOT OBSERVATION (hypothesis, not proof): CURRENT-READER.py walk(x,collect=False) ignores collect and recurses over the whole stream plus quoted JSON, so internal tool arguments / quoted JSON / final result text can all become terminal-review candidates. This is the plausible source of B's completeTerminalReviews=2 (two whole objects differing only at findings[5] B-I6, 0-style vs 0-style per PUBLIC-DIFFERENCE.json), versus A's clean single object. I did NOT inspect any raw event; which private event produced each B object is unproven and unassumed.

FIX: new opt-in flag --export-terminal-review that implies export_only before dispatch (no provider launch/retry), rejects non-claude providers, and selects via a pure, self-contained function (select_terminal_structured_review) EXACTLY the typed structured_output dict on the single successful result event — no text/partial/nested-tool/quoted fallback; the recursive walk is unused on this path, so a contradictory valid nested/quoted draft cannot override the final typed object. STOP (named reason, no partial salvage) on: non-claude provider, requested model != claude-opus-5-5, exit != 0 or None, pins changed, no actual assistant frames, mixed/wrong actual model (e.g. 4.8), zero or multiple terminal result events, failed/non-success result, absent/string structured_output, token mismatch, schema-invalid, or canonical object not byte-identical to one retained public whole candidate. On EXPORT it appends only TERMINAL-REVIEW.json and TERMINAL-EXPORT.json via exclusive-create (never overwrites), never mutates PROCESS/REVIEW/AMBIGUOUS/WHOLE records, records legacyRecursiveWholeObjectCount (preserving, not falsifying, the old record), and exports no secrets/partials/raw. The normal and ordinary --export-only paths are unchanged.

AUTHORITY vs JUDGMENT: the flag performs authority selection (provider-canonical artifact identity) only; it does not pick a convenient vote, splice, edit any judgment field, or decide B's disposition — B's multiplicity STOP stays open. A valid typed field proves artifact identity only, not crypto/runtime/materiality.

UNIT PREP (authored, not run): test_terminal_review_selection.py AST-extracts ONLY the pure selector and exec's that one node with json+jsonschema; it never imports/runs the whole candidate or any job/private logic. 20 frozen methods; derived UNIT envelopes modeled on the public B/A objects (not real provider records or ledger data); expected RED = selector absent -> all error; expected GREEN = all 20 pass; bounded effects (one public-file read for AST extraction, no writes, no new deps beyond stdlib/jsonschema, no private reads). No actual unit run performed.

GATING: adoption/implementation/unit/real-export require two fresh agreeing actual Opus 5.5 audits + one ordinary unit verification + a root decision, in that order; the author does not vote. nativeAuthority 0; broader Moriarty/financial/PCD/Preprod untouched.

PRECISE GAP: the provider-envelope contract (whether structured_output is emitted at most once on the terminal result, and whether B's second object came from quoted/nested text vs a second result event) lives only in raw provider.private.jsonl, which must not be read. That contract is the named gap; it is not read or assumed. The flag resolves which retained B object is canonical at runtime (rule 11) and STOPs if none matches.

Four files written to terminal-export-source-output: run_source_task_candidate.py, test_terminal_review_selection.py, READER-PATCH.diff, EXPORT-POLICY.md. CURRENT-READER.py / live run_source_task.py and all current jobs are untouched.

files.purpose: Entire existing reader, byte-unchanged on the normal and ordinary --export-only paths, plus (a) the pure, self-contained selection function select_terminal_structured_review and (b) a new --export-terminal-review branch that implies export_only, rejects non-claude providers, selects only the single terminal result.structured_output dict, and appends TERMINAL-REVIEW.json/TERMINAL-EXPORT.json via exclusive-create without mutating any existing record.

Unit preparation (authored, not run): AST-extracts ONLY the pure selector and exec's that one function with json+jsonschema; 20 frozen methods over derived UNIT envelopes covering stream multiplicity, canonical-only selection, and every STOP rejection; records expected RED/GREEN and bounded effects.
Unified, proposal-only diff (NOT applied) from CURRENT-READER.py to the candidate, showing the two additive changes and stating the normal/export-only paths are unchanged.

Policy: the observed bug and its limits, the fix and selection contract/STOP list, authority-selection vs unique-judgment, why fresh independent Opus 5.5 review is required before use, unit-prep summary (frozen count/RED/GREEN/bounded effects/no run now), and the named private-envelope gap that is not read or assumed.

limitations: Source only. Nothing was executed, imported, compiled, hashed, tested, run, or version-controlled; no SDK/VM/native/provider invocation. Read/Write/Edit only.
No private capture/provider stderr/debug/auth/config/key/PK/SRS/cache/home/researchroot was read; only the 9 public packet bodies at the exact manifest paths.

The root cause (recursive walk collecting quoted/nested/text objects) is a source-level hypothesis, not proof; the raw stream that would show which private event produced each B object was not inspected and is not assumed.
The provider-envelope contract (uniqueness of result.structured_output; origin of B's second object) is the named gap; it lives only in raw provider.private.jsonl and was neither read nor assumed.
The proposal does not approve implementation, adoption, unit execution, or real export, and does not decide B's security disposition; B's multiplicity STOP remains open.
The unit test is authored but not run; RED/GREEN/bounded-effects are recorded expectations, and its fixtures are derived UNIT envelopes, not real provider records or ledger data.
A valid typed structured_output field proves provider-artifact identity only, not any cryptographic/runtime property or finding materiality; no security-judgment field is altered.
Session model identity is ambiguous: initialised as Opus 5.5 but a later injected system line claimed Opus 4.8. Flagged honestly; not resolved by me and not used to relabel anything.

nativeAuthority 0; no project tests/SDK/prover/VM/ledger/wallet touched; broader Moriarty/financial/PCD/Preprod work untouched. CURRENT-READER/live run_source_task.py and all current jobs are unchanged.
